title: zj-initiative-registry Skill implementation
description: Implement the ZAgentic Skill that manages the GitHub-hosted ZInitiatives Registry.

decisions.q: 共享 Registry 的事实源采用什么形式？
decisions.answer: ZInitiatives GitHub repository；分片 manifests 是维护输入，global-initiative-registry.json/Markdown/Mermaid 是确定性生成物
decisions.note: ZAgentic 只实现管理 Skill，不持有共享 Registry 数据

decisions.q: 第一阶段实施范围是什么？
decisions.answer: 先完成 bootstrap、compile、validate 最小闭环，再实现 register/drift 和 Git PR 协作
decisions.note: 不在第一阶段自动修改 Initiative 仓库，不聚合 Plan 运行时状态

1-1.label: Bootstrap ZInitiatives Registry structure and protocol fixtures
1-1.notes: ZInitiatives bootstrap fixture, protocol schemas, generated JSON/Markdown/Mermaid, and maintenance rules added.

1-2.label: Deterministic manifest compiler and generated registry outputs
1-2.notes: Deterministic Python compiler generates JSON, Markdown, and Mermaid views from sorted manifests.

1-3.label: Schema, path, and roadmap validation
1-3.notes: Manifest schema, cross-reference, local path, generated freshness, and roadmap validation added.

1-4.label: Register, remove, show, and semantic diff workflows
1-4.notes: Registry admin CLI supports register, remove with confirmation, show, and ID-level semantic diff.

1-5.label: Git branch, PR, sync, and checkout-map workflows
1-5.notes: Safe Git workflow helper supports dry-run/execute sync, scoped branch naming, publish command plans, and device-local checkout maps.

1-6.label: Skill packaging, plugin registration, and end-to-end acceptance
1-6.notes: Skill packaged with wrapper and command reference; bucket, top-level catalog, plugin metadata, and glossary updated; local Registry E2E passed.
